title: The new `suspended` prop is covered only at the ConfigScreen integration level.…
body: The new `suspended` prop is covered only at the ConfigScreen integration level. Consider a direct TabBar unit test asserting Left/Right fires when suspended=false and stands down when suspended=true, to pin the presentational contract independently of its one caller.

title: textInputFocused suppresses for both notify-recipient (fieldFocus===3) and noti…
body: textInputFocused suppresses for both notify-recipient (fieldFocus===3) and notify-sender (fieldFocus===4), but only the recipient branch is exercised by a test; the sender branch relies on symmetry. A dedicated fieldFocus===4 case would close the last uncovered sub-condition.
